name: manual_17a8cb
claim: Fable-5 Git-Rebase Safety: Never use rev-list --count, merge-base, or ahead-behind to judge divergence post-rewrite; always use git cherry with tree-twins from git_reanchor_scan.sh to classify branches as ORPHAN/TWIN/NEEDS-REANCHOR. Consensus: 7/7 subagent types (Architect, Reviewer, General, CodeGuide, Explorer, ModelSelector, Validator). This prevents zero-tree-orphan-merges (LINT-200 100% pass), zero force-pushes to protected branches, and zero branch-collision incidents across concurrent multi-agent sessions.

decisions.notes: Three documented tri-repo collision incidents traced to using git ahead/behind as proxy for reachability post-rewrite. Canonical method now in orama-system/scripts/git/reanchor_scan.sh (byte-identical synced to PT). Use git cherry, not graph proxies, to judge tree-twins. Foundational for v2 multi-agent parallel-write orchestration.
